title: Purification of Mouse Pancreatic Islets using Histopaque Gradient Centrifugation
author: Nancy Smith

steps_raw.instruction: Solution Prep - 1X Hanks Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) - Sigma H6136
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Measure out 900ml of room temperature H 2 O 900 mL, MiliQ water
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating While gently stirring the water, add the powdered medium. Stir until dissolved. DO NOT HEAT.
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Rinse original vial with water to remove traces and add to above.
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Add 0.35g sodium bicarbonate and stir until dissolved. 0.35 g, Sodium Bicarbonate
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Adjust pH to 7.4
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Bring solution to 1L
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Add 4ml of 30% BSA (equitech bio, inc 160928-0262) to the prepared 1X HBSS
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Store at 4°C 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Solution Prep - Mouse Islet Culture Media
steps_raw.instruction: Add FBS and Pen/Strep to bottle of RPMI %s %s

steps_raw.title: Solution Prep - Mouse Islet Culture Media
steps_raw.instruction: Store at 4°C 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Once digest of pancreas in the waterbath is complete (see Mouse Pancreatic Islet Isolation protocol, Step 16) https://www.protocols.io/view/mouse-pancreatic-islet-isolation-sqaedse Shake 50ml falcon tube 30 times.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C 02:00:00 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Remove supernatant

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Re-suspend pellet in 20ml of 1X HBSS+BSA. Pour re-suspended pellet through #60 screen (cell dissociation sieve, Sigma CD1-1KT) that has been rinsed with coating. Using a 30ml syringe filled with 1X HBSS+BSA and 18G needle rinse screen (use about 20ml). Return islets to 50ml tube and rinse the beaker with the remaining 10ml of 1X HBSS+BSA, add it to the tube.

Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Take 34ml of the prepared 1X HBSS and add 6ml of 30% BSA (equitech bio, inc 160928-0262) in a 50ml falcon tube. This is to be used for coating.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C 02:00:00 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Remove supernatant. Add 10ml 1X HBSS+BSA, re-suspend pellet. Bring up the volume to 50ml with 1X HBSS+BSA.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C 02:00:00 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Remove supernatant. Add 10ml 1X HBSS+BSA, re-suspend pellet. Bring up the volume to 50ml with 1X HBSS+BSA.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C 02:00:00 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Remove supernatant. Leave tube upside down on papertowel to drip dry (30 seconds). Wipe the interior of the tube with a Kimwipe using a long forceps (do not touch the pellet). Leave tubes upright on ice.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Re-suspend the pellet with 5ml of Histopaque 1077 (Sigma 1077-1 500ml) with pipette that has been rinsed with coating. Add another 5ml of Histopaque and mix using coated pipette.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Lay the tube at an angle on ice. Add gradually 10ml of the Mouse Media to ensure that the two mediums do not mix.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 339 g at 4°C with the brake turned off . 30:00:00 4 °C Some centrifuges have an acceleration/deceleration speed setting. Use slowest rate of speed for both acceleration and deceleration .

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (both layers) into a new single 50ml falcon tube. Bring up to volume with 1X HBSS+BSA. Keep tubes with the pellet on ice. If islets are not in the the supernatant, they may be in the pellet and can be recovered by hand picking in Mouse Islet Media.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 339 g at 4°C. 03:00:00 4 °C

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Decant the supernatant. Re-suspend the pellet in 10 ml of Mouse Media.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Hand pick islets if desired or necessary. Incubate islets in Mouse Islet Media at 37°C with 5% CO 2 until ready for use in experiment.

steps_raw.title: Gradient Protocol
steps_raw.instruction: Bring up volume to 50ml by adding 1X HBSS+BSA to falcon tube.
